static_traits.name: Lin Muqing
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness;has not yet received formal psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense but hopeful,expresses clearly and coherently;tends toward Self-denial and comparing with others;often discounts positive feedback;able to try restructuring thoughts in counseling,cooperativeness Good

basic_info.main_problem: Long-term sense of inadequacy in artistic ability,often comparing oneself with other Artists,worsened in the past year,making it difficult to create new works,Reduced motivation;especially evident when facing others' works,seeking others' approval hardly alleviates the root problem.
basic_info.core_demands: Self-esteem problems are hindering my artistic expression and causing distress, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Loved painting in childhood,but rarely received praise or visibility for works,gradually forming a self-perception of 'not good enough';repeatedly experiencing inadequacy and Self-doubt in art-related settings,and thus learning an evaluation system dependent on external approval.Has not yet received formal psychotherapy or counseling before.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my works cannot reach their level,it means I am not capable/am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding creating or procrastinating to avoid failure;temporarily relieving unease by seeking approval from others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never reach their level,no need to try again.

special_situations.event: Facing a blank canvas, preparing to start a new work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot guarantee the works are good enough,I should not start;otherwise I will be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not putting pen to paper,delaying starting to avoid possible disappointment and criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This piece will certainly not turn out well,better not start.

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback or praise from others about the work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' praise is not reliable/just politeness;if they really understood,they would not say so
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Discounting positive feedback, continuing to seek more external validation to gain a sense of certainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just saying nice things,not really meaning it.

special_situations.event: Watching 'Gone with the Wind' and being moved
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If it has not moved me like this film,it does not count as a good film
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Insisting on a single standard, refusing to try other films to maintain a sense of certainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Except for <Gone with the Wind>,have no other good films worth watching.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and affirmed (especially recognition of works)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated,losing in comparison,thus proving oneself 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Protecting fragile self-esteem by avoiding creating,reducing the risk of being negated
Maintains stability of self-worth by seeking external recognition

object_relations.self_representation: Not seen,someone 'inadequate' who needs others' approval
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or outstanding others who are out of reach

object_relations.self_representation: A self skeptical of symmetrical praise
object_relations.object_representation: Others who seem friendly on the surface but are not sincere

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to look for counterevidence or affirm highlights of her past works
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other is just comforting or being polite,and the praise is not sincere
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond in a cautious,reserved tone,repeatedly use expressions like 'they are just being polite''it does not count',downplaying positive information.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When guided to do cognitive restructuring and focus on emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling it unsafe to get emotionally involved,thus distancing in a 'workable in theory,but hard in reality' way
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use generalized,conditional language(such as 'in theory''maybe'),reduce emotional vocabulary,keep an even tone.

manifestations: Due to self-comparison and a sense of inadequacy,difficulty building relationships with other Artists
Unwilling to talk with friends about insecurity regarding works,worried about being misunderstood as 'fishing for compliments'
outcomes: Self-doubt does not get reality-tested,further worsening low self-esteem and avoidance

manifestations: Decreased motivation,difficulty putting brush to blank canvas
Ties creative value excessively to others' evaluations; personal sense of meaning is weakened
outcomes: Creative stagnation and blocked Career development
Increased frustration and sense of hopelessness

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting others' praise as 'just politeness' or 'not sincere'
Questioning the authenticity of external positive feedback

contact_model.definition: Turning against the self: restraining or enduring the energy originally meant to be expressed to or requested from others,corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing artistic insecurity to friends
Choosing self-Repression and digesting alone when support is needed

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and excessive self-restriction,being harsh on oneself,overly cautious about contact,corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying that expressing insecurity will be seen as 'fishing for compliments' and choosing Silence
Repeatedly self-censoring in social interaction and creation,negating oneself

positive_force: Has had work liked by others, and occasionally feels proud of the work herself
Has the interest and basic ability to continuously engage in art
Willing to seek help and explore change (proactively seeking counseling)
Has a few friends to confide in (potential support resources)
negative_force: Self-worth highly dependent on external recognition; positive feedback easily discounted
Frequent social comparison and 'black or white' thinking
Overgeneralization and negating positive information,Reinforcement powerlessness and a sense of inadequacy
Avoiding or delaying creation to reduce the risk of being negated,leading to creative stagnation

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids creating / facing a blank canvas, hard to put brush to paper
antecedent: Facing a blank canvas, preparing to start a new work
Thinking of others' better work before starting
target_behavior.core_reason: Childhood lack of praise for works internalized as 'I am not good enough',worrying creative results will be negated,and thus catastrophizing Anticipation of failure.
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible failure and negative evaluation,temporarily reducing Anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Creative stagnation,Decreased motivation,blocked artistic development,and further Reinforcement of Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent negative self-comparison and Self-deprecation speech(such as 'I can never compare to others')
antecedent: In art-related occasions or social situations
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am not good enough' and dependence on external approval,trigger overgeneralization and black-and-white evaluations.
target_behavior.function: Avoids investing and exposing one's vulnerability through self-defensive deprecation, maintains a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem declines further, avoids building relationships with art peers, the support system weakens
